scope: Publication privacy and monotonic message-ID completeness audit of genuine full BAND console export; in-progress snapshot, not final run outcome.

rejected_first_console_retry.disposition: Preserved unchanged as incomplete first UI download; successful second genuine UI download is the audited source.

privacy.method: Scan every JSON string leaf including metadata, tool payloads, outputs and source text; recursively decode supported embedded JSON and Python literal payloads, then scan decoded string leaves. Review auth-shaped source literals by context and prior audited synthetic fingerprints without emitting values. Additional structural credential-field and personal-data-label/phone-shape scans were empty.
privacy.email_classification: All observed addresses use synthetic fixture domains.

publication_gate: This exact SHA-bound full console JSON may replace the prior room.json unchanged. The earlier incomplete console download must not replace room.json.
limitations: Pattern scanning, recursive structured decoding and bounded contextual review cannot prove absence of every novel or encoded secret.
ID retention and content comparisons establish monotonic completeness relative to the prior published console snapshot; no independent API-total assertion is made.
Export is a timestamped in-progress room snapshot and does not establish final Stage 4 or whole-run acceptance.
mutation_scope: Only this new audit receipt was written under the audit directory. Canonical repository, raw exports, factory source, product and runtime were not modified; no BAND messages or service API mutations were made.
